title: Continuity — launch film
logline: For design engineers who have seen too much sloppy AI video: Continuity gives agents a studio process and eyes, so what they make is good enough to ship. Open source.

scenes.intent: Name the problem in one breath: agents can write motion, but they can't see it.

beats.note: 'Agents can write motion.' rises word by word, in fg, a focus caret after it
line 1 steps back to the grey; 'They just can't see it.' rises (the scene's moment)
everything but 'see' steps back to the grey: the problem, picked out by ink

elements.note: First line of the scene's one statement: a single <Headline> (display, 112) holding l1 and l2 as block spans, left on the safe edge, vertically centred. fg, then the grey at b2.
A 6×96px caret in the focus colour after 'motion.': the agent typing. The only accent in the frame; blinks (m.blink) until b2.
Second line, directly under l1 (same Headline). fg; at b3 it steps back to the grey except 'see'.
Inline span inside l2, pinned to text-fg so it keeps its ink when the rest of l2 dims. Emphasis by ink, never a colour or italic.

scenes.motion: Solid canvas, no light (the world before eyes). b1: l1 maskUp by words (responsive, word stagger 40ms); the caret fades in with it and blinks until b2-0.08, then fades out. b2: l1 `dim` (instant) as l2 maskUp by words on the expressive spring — the scene's one moment. b3: l2 `dim` (instant); 'see' keeps fg. Camera 1 → 1.03 anchored on the safe left edge (origin x 96), so the type never drifts and the cut into the turn doesn't snap. Nothing exits; hard cut on the beat into the light.

Camera 1 → 1.03 anchored on the safe left edge, like the hook. Push into the first chapter.

scenes.intent: Plan before pixels: the director writes a storyboard of scenes, copy and timed beats before any code.

beats.note: headline masks up; the storyboard window came with the push
rows, lanes and beat keyframes have landed
this scene's row takes the raised segment and steps up to fg

text.headline: Plan before pixels.
text.sub: Scenes and beats, timed before code.

elements.note: <Label> '01 · Plan' (repeats the station's word), 8px above the headline.
<Headline> display (112), fg, in the 608px lockup column on the safe edge: ≤ 2 lines, broken by meaning. The product sits 96px to its right (litt's split frame).
<Body> (36, the grey), 32px under the headline.
<Window title="storyboard.json"> 1024×640 on the right (columns 7–12), vertically centred with the lockup. Body: `rows` left (448px), `lanes` right, a status bar at the bottom.

5 rows (rows-r0…r4, the List's 88px rhythm, 2px hairlines): 'hook · the problem' 3.6s | 'studio · the turn' 4.4s | 'plan · storyboard' 4.8s | 'check · eyes on frames' 7.0s | 'measure · motion chart' 5.0s. Titles in the grey; this scene's title (title2) steps up to fg.
The raised segment (surface-2, hairline + top highlight) behind this scene's row: P12's 'current item'.
5 beat lanes (lane0…lane4) on a shared seconds axis: 8px rails at fg 12%, width ∝ duration; beat keyframes (tick0…) at the storyboard's real beat times, fg 55%, this scene's in fg (BarChart's rule).

Lanes `wipeRight` from 0.6 (list 40ms), keyframes `fade` from 0.9 (40ms), all landed by b2. b3: `current` fades in and title2 `ink`s to fg. Camera 1 → 1.03.

scenes.intent: Eyes on every frame: the contact sheet shows a defect, the gate names it, the fix turns it green.

beats.note: headline; frames fade on from the centre at b1+0.3
`pnpm ct check launch` types
RED: two findings tagged 'error', a danger ring on f5, the other frames recede, camera focus push; holds ≥ 1.4s
GREEN: f5's headline lifts off the CTA, the ring clears, 'error' → 'fixed', the ✔ line is placed, the sheet returns

text.label: 02 · Check
text.headline: Eyes on every frame.
text.sub: A contact sheet and a gate, every cut.

elements.note: <Label> '02 · Check'.
<Headline> display (112), one line. Check is the one stacked chapter (lockup above, product 96px below at full width): the sheet and the gate need the room.
<Body>, the grey.
<Card> (flat) 893×600: header 'sheet.png' / 'launch · 31.6s' (mono 26, the grey) over a 3×3 grid of 16:9 thumbnails, 267×150, 14px gaps.
Thumbnails f0…f8: miniatures of this film in litt (canvas or the top light, fg/grey type bars, raised UI boxes, a focus caret, an accent button on the end card). Shapes only, no readable text.
The defect frame: an end-card draft whose wordmark bar `f5b` overlaps the button `f5a`; its caption `f5c` is too faint.
4px danger outline (rounded-surface) 8px outside f5: the gate's mark.
<Window title="zsh"> 803×600. Body stacks `cmd`, `scan`, the `report` box, `done`.
Grey `$` prompt waiting, then cmd-l0 'pnpm ct check launch' types (fg).
<Terminal> '◆ 948 frames · 7 scenes' in the grey.

Report box (surface-2, hairline). 2 rows findings-r0/r1: titles title0 'overlap · headline × cta', title1 'contrast 3.1:1 · caption', meta 'f5', a status Tag err0/err1 'error' (danger word) that swaps to ok0/ok1 'fixed' (success word).
<Terminal> '✔ 0 errors · 0 warnings' (success). Line done-l0.

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. The push brings both surfaces in. b1: headline maskUp lines (responsive), sub rise; frames `fade` from the centre (grid 40ms). b2: the command types (24 cps); the scan line fades in. b3: report + findings `rise` (list); ring fades in at the instant tier; the other frames recede to 40% (slow, inOut); the camera focus-pushes 1.01 → 1.03 (slow, inOut). b4: f5b lifts 22px (responsive), f5c to full opacity, ring `fadeOut`; err → ok swap at the instant tier, titles `dim`; done-l0 `settle` — the scene's one moment; frames return. Push on.

scenes.intent: Motion, measured: rhythm, easing and dead air are numbers the agent checks, not vibes.

<Body>, the grey.
<Window title="ct motion · launch.mp4"> 1024×600 on the right, vertically centred with the lockup. Body: the energy plot on top, the verdict row underneath.

scenes.intent: A critic scores every cut on five axes, and only the best version ships.

beats.note: headline in; the scorecard came with the push (labels, empty meters, 0.0)
meters fill and scores count
verdict: 'Ships', best of 3

<Headline> display (112), fg, in the 608px lockup column on the safe edge: ≤ 2 lines, broken by meaning. The product sits 96px to its right (litt's split frame).
<Body>, the grey.
<Card> (flat) 1024×600 on the right: the five axes, a 2px hairline, then the mean (left) and the verdict (right).

5 rows ax0…ax4: label (small, the grey) 'Intent' 'Composition' 'Typography' 'Temporal' 'Craft'; <Meter ct=bar0…bar4 width=552> filled with fg, 0.92/0.88/0.96/0.90/0.94; mono counters v0…v4 → 4.6 / 4.4 / 4.8 / 4.5 / 4.7.
<Stat value={4.6} decimals={1} label="v3 · mean score" unit="/ 5">, title size: label above value, tabular.
<Tag tone="success">Ships</Tag>: the verdict as a word.
<Caption> 'best of 3 versions', just before the tag.

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. The push brings the scorecard in. b1: headline maskUp lines (responsive), sub rise. b2: meter fills scaleX 0 → 1 and the five counters run together (slow, inOut, list 40ms); the mean counts over linger. b3: `ships` `settle` — the scene's one moment — and `best` fades in. ≥ 1s of settled hold before the dip. Camera 1 → 1.03.
